name: Bastion Lunchbox Fixes
derivation: Exact known-working v13 Bastion patch core with option gates, prefixed by an independently implemented Codex Module Bridge v1 compatibility dispatcher
preserved_v13_behavior: 14 exact zone hashes and expected HP checks
intentional_changes_from_v13: Removed unrelated experimental Main Health HUD
Added three boolean option gates around the existing v13 plan() writes
Added eight mutually exclusive Arsenal configurations
v1.0.4 prepends a Codex Module Bridge v1 compatibility dispatcher before the unchanged Bastion runtime core

codex_module_bridge_v1_compatibility.purpose: Allow the independently distributed Codex Module Bridge v1 and Bastion Lunchbox Fix to remain installed together despite both defining mods/codex/gun_calibration
codex_module_bridge_v1_compatibility.required_load_order: Bastion Lunchbox Fix must have winning priority for mods/codex/gun_calibration
codex_module_bridge_v1_compatibility.behavior: Uses stingray.Application.can_get before require, isolates lookup/load failures, and uses the CodexModuleBridge global guard to prevent duplicate initialization
codex_module_bridge_v1_compatibility.scope: Compatibility is specifically for Codex Module Bridge v1 behavior observed in the supplied package; future bridge versions require revalidation

variants.name: Lunch Heavy Armor + Side Skirts 0% Main

compatibility_warning: Still uses mods/codex/gun_calibration. Codex Module Bridge v1 is supported only when this mod wins that resource. HUD Ballistic Trajectory Overlay v2 remains incompatible with this implementation.
static_datalibrary_note: A decoded generated_entities.dl_bin contains the proven Bastion structure at 0x994006, but the retail loose DataLibrary is encrypted. Deploying the decoded bytes directly is not a valid replacement, so v1.0.4 retains the proven runtime writer.
superseded_builds: v1.0.0-v1.0.2 used a reconstructed layout/locator and are superseded by v1.0.3+.
